annotations.title: See what students said about their diet

description: Across ALL students at once (list_diet_feedback is one student): notes the trainer's students sent about their diet or one of its meals (e.g. "can't eat this much rice"), newest first, in the last days (default 14, up to 90), with student_name, phone (the guardian's for a dependent), meal_name (empty = the whole plan), message, plan_id and app_url of that student's diet screen. Use it to answer "did anyone complain about the diet?"; get_diet_plan(plan_id) shows the plan. Read only: nothing is answered or changed.

days.description: Look-back window in days, 1 to 90. Default 14.

name: get_diet_feedback_overview
title: See what students said about their diet
